notes.title: Version 1.0.9.3 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Rebinding of "retry room" was not getting saved properly in settings
[*]New setting in settings menu to control frame update timing. If you are experiencing abnormal game speeds, try changing this (experimental)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.9.2 Update
notes.content:
The new version is live, and with any luck this one will stick and solve all the existing issues some users were having, and not create any new issues.

[h1]Change notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed from MonoGame/SDL2 to XNA 4.0 for Windows build (Mac and Linux builds still use MonoGame). Controller support and general compatibility should improve, as well as fix the "crash on start" error some users were getting.
[*]Localization improvements, including new Spanish fan translation. [b]Escape Goat is now a proper EFIGS title![/b]
[*]Restored the "entrance door" background decoration for where the goat enters the room
[/list]
Enjoy, and be sure to let me know if you run into any issues. Thanks everyone for making the Steam launch of Escape Goat a big success.
